desc: Update one or more properties of an existing organizational usergroup.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

id.desc: ID of the usergroup to update

handle.desc: The handle used for mentioning the group in a channel, must be unique.

is_visible.desc: Configure whether or not this usergroup should be visible in the client.

channel_limit_user_ids.desc: List of user IDs who would exceed their channel limit

feature_not_enabled.desc: The Admin APIs feature is not enabled for this workspace.

invalid_auth.desc: The workspace specified is not part of this organization.

restricted_action.desc: The calling user cannot modify the specified usergroup, or the usergroup is managed by an identity provider (IdP) and its name cannot be changed through this API.

not_an_enterprise.desc: The token passed in does not belong to an Enterprise organization.

invalid_usergroup.desc: A usergroup with the specified ID does not exist.

name_already_exists.desc: The name specified is used by another usergroup and cannot be updated.

handle_already_exists.desc: The handle specified is used by another usergroup or entity and cannot be updated.

visible_group_needs_handle.desc: Tried to set the group to visible but did not provide a handle.

too_many_usergroup_members_to_make_visib.desc: Tried to set the group to visible but the group has too many members

user_channel_limit_exceeded.desc: Adding these channels would cause one or more members to exceed their channel limit.

cannot_modify_pref_after_creation.desc: This preference can only be set when the group is created and cannot be changed afterward.
